configuration.title: Electivus Apex Logs
configuration.electivus.apexLogViewer.lo: Number of logs to fetch per page (effective maximum: 200). Higher values fetch more per request but may slow the UI or increase API load.
Maximum concurrent requests to fetch log headers. Very high values may overload Salesforce APIs or hit rate limits.
configuration.electivus.apexLogViewer.ta: Lines kept in the Tail view's rolling buffer. Larger buffers use more memory and CPU.
configuration.electivus.apexLogViewer.lo: Enable verbose extension and shared-core trace logging in the Electivus Apex Log Viewer output channel.
configuration.electivus.apexLogViewer.cu: **Experimental.** Show the **Custom Logs** panel and its commands (Refresh Custom Logs, Open Custom Logs in Editor Area, Configure Custom Logs Sources) for logs your org keeps as records or publishes as platform events, such as Nebula Logger's `Log__c` records and `LogEntryEvent__e` events. Off by default while the feature is in development. The `sf electivus custom-log` CLI commands do not depend on this setting.
configuration.electivus.apexLogViewer.lo: Persisted column layout for the Logs table (managed by the Logs panel UI). Stores visibility/order/widths in user settings so it survives reloads and can sync across machines.
